description: Return in one call recorded mappings plus the active shipped and registered team traits and objects, with a canonical ETag and generatedAt. Objects are the business objects; OODS Foundry's internal objects are included only when includeInternal is true, each object carries its visibility, and registry.hiddenInternal counts the ones left out. registry states the live source, names and loader issues, including the shadowed shipped Subscription. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities remain historical mapping storage fields and are not advertised as snapshot capabilities.

inputSchema.description: Bulk-read recorded mappings plus live shipped and registered team traits and objects. Reports definition loader issues, including shadowed names. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities are not snapshot outputs.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

name: registry_snapshot
